meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 的群组可以把 agent 后端从 Claude 换成 OpenAI 的 Codex（也可并存）。Codex 作为子进程通过 stdio 用 JSON-RPC 通信，支持流式输出、MCP 工具、服务端历史/续聊；密钥只存在 vault，不写入 .env 或容器。
howto.when: 当操作员在宿主上执行 `ncl groups config update --provider codex` 并重启该组时，该组由 Codex 接管（需先安装并完成 vault 认证；默认仍为 claude，要显式切换）。

say.text: 安装 add-codex 技能，把 Codex 配成可用的 agent 后端。
say.note: 会执行安装脚本并注册 provider。

say.text: 把群组 42 的 provider 切到 codex 并重启。
say.note: 该组后续对话由 Codex 处理。

say.text: 用我的 OpenAI API key 完成 Codex 认证。
say.note: 会走 vault 认证流程，不暴露密钥。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw groups can switch their agent backend from Claude to OpenAI's Codex. Codex runs as a child process over stdio (JSON-RPC) with streaming, MCP tools, server-side history/resume. Credentials live only in the vault.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an operator runs `ncl groups config update --provider codex` on the host and restarts the group, after the provider is installed and authenticated. New groups stay on claude unless explicitly switched.

say_en.text: Install the add-codex skill and make Codex an available agent backend.
say_en.note: Runs the setup and registers the provider.

say_en.text: Switch group 42's provider to codex and restart it.
say_en.note: That group's future turns use Codex.

say_en.text: Authenticate Codex with my OpenAI API key.
say_en.note: Runs the vault auth flow without exposing the key.
